caseNameFull: Kansas City Power & Light Co. v. State Corporation Commission of Kansas

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Kan. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 479 U. S. 1082.] Motion of Edison Electric Institute for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted.

Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
